title: Admissible evaluation attestation
description: An external observer's signed statement that one evaluation produced exactly these records, for exactly this artefact, in exactly this attempt, and that the observer read a closed receipt for that run from a provider outside it. It is what lets a finalizer treat command evidence as more than a description: the job that produced those records ran candidate-owned commands and cannot be its own witness, and an attestation over the preview alone would only restate the candidate's account of itself. What it establishes is bounded: an operator or an adapter reported reading that source receipt. Admissible does not fetch it and cannot verify it, so a dishonest adapter produces an attestation that verifies -- the adapter-honesty assumption is retained deliberately. Authenticity is HMAC-SHA256 shared-secret authenticity, not public non-repudiation. This is a different domain from a review attestation and from the admission receipt, and none of the three keys substitutes for another.

key_id.description: The observer that signed. A finalizer refuses any key id its pinned ADMISSIBLE_EVALUATION_KEYRING does not name.

preview_schema.description: The exact preview protocol the observer parsed. Signed so an older or candidate-invented envelope cannot be relabelled after observation.

issued_at.description: The preview issuance time observed. It must equal both the preview issued_at and the embedded decision evaluated_at.

attempt_id.description: The single attempt observed. A finalizer refuses unless this equals the attempt the preview's decision names.

command_digests.description: Sorted evidence digests of every command record observed. Checked in both directions: a record the observer did not watch cannot be counted, and a record it watched cannot be dropped afterwards.

state.description: The decision state observed. Never ADMITTED: an evaluation signs nothing, and only a durable receipt records an admission.

config_path.description: The exact policy file this evaluation was decided under. A finalizer re-reads this file and no other.

fork.description: Whether the evaluated head came from a fork. Signed, so it cannot be cleared afterwards: a fork prohibition outside the signature is one that fails open.

dependencies.description: Sorted dependency edges the receipt would record. Inside the signature so the graph cannot be edited after observation.

isolation.description: The boundary the external observer independently asserts after validating infrastructure evidence in its own trust domain. It is never copied from the candidate-adjacent preview. The evaluating job kills each check process group, but a descendant that calls setsid() escapes it; a finalizer therefore refuses 'none'. Admissible authenticates who asserted the boundary, not the hypervisor or namespace itself.

source_receipt.description: The closed receipt the observer read from a system outside this evaluation.

run_id.description: An immutable run or job id at that provider.

conclusion.description: What the provider reported. The finalizer applies the matrix only to readiness it independently recomputes from evidence and trusted policy: READY_FOR_ATTESTATION accepts success only; genuine AWAITING_REVIEW accepts success or failure; NOT_READY accepts no conclusion. The observer-bound readiness cannot widen that set; cancelled and timed_out are always refused.

receipt_digest.description: The digest of the receipt document, or the canonical digest of the source document itself.
